about: Reviewed dispositions for npm audit advisories that cannot be fixed by an available upgrade. Read by scripts/dependency-check.cjs (npm run security:check). One entry covers exactly one advisory on one package at one installed version; when that version changes the entry is stale and the check fails until it is re-reviewed. There are no package-group or path suppressions. The resolved list is documentation of advisories cleared by upgrades in Tasks 8 and 10 of plan 01 and suppresses nothing.

dispositions.usage: node_modules/npm/node_modules/brace-expansion, bundled inside npm@11.21.0 (inBundle) under @semantic-release/npm@13.2.0. Release tooling only; never enters the published package or the skill bundles.
dispositions.reason: Quadratic-time expansion in the {a},b} rewrite (CPU DoS). The file ships inside npm's own tarball, so neither overrides nor npm audit fix can replace it. npm 11.21.0 is the newest 11.x and @semantic-release/npm requires npm@^11.6.2 (12.x is out of range). npm's glob input here is semantic-release's own file patterns, not untrusted data.
dispositions.recheck: When npm 11.x ships brace-expansion >=5.0.12 or @semantic-release/npm accepts npm 12.
